purpose: Correct popularity-conditional probability bias without tuning ticket allocation or historical ROI.
base_training_end: 2024-12-31 for reconstructed calibration predictions; 2025-12-31 for frozen 2026 model
fit_races: All complete JRA flat G1/G2/G3 races available in the supplied feature archive, validated against public final entries and ranking; exclude incomplete fields and top-three dead heats.
fit_outcome: ordered top-three ranking negative log likelihood per race
optimizer: scipy L-BFGS-B, deterministic fixed start alpha=0.5 beta=0.5; check bounded optima and gradients
evaluation_context: 2026 outcomes were already inspected to diagnose the original model. This comparison is a retrospective temporal holdout for coefficient fitting, not independent prospective proof.
allocation: balanced_A_v3 unchanged exact-10000-yen budget, minimum-only stakes, same default solver settings
joint_probability_requirement: A single corrected strength drives horse marginals, all pair/triple probabilities and union hit chance; never independently rescale combination probabilities.
deployment_gates: candidate improves mean ordered-top3 and both pair/triple logloss vs old strength in 2026 and does not worsen aggregate horse probability Brier
improvement does not reverse direction in H1/H2 split for ordered-top3 logloss
portfolio actual-vs-estimated hit-rate gap narrows and total official ROI is not below old fixed-rule replay
candidate is at least competitive with market-only probability baseline; if AI coefficient is zero explicitly report no retained AI contribution
live data acquisition, odds freshness, publication roundtrip and runtime/deadline checks must pass before production activation
deployment_policy: Conditional. Do not activate merely because a retrospective ROI improved. Preserve all original models, allocations and historical predictions. If a gate fails, save rejection and do not alter production.
limitations: final odds, final starter sets, original archive point-in-time alignment uncertified
103 races are too few for profit guarantees
